title: Lemon Asparagus Pasta
description: This citrusy lemon asparagus pasta is a delicious combo of crisp-tender asparagus with penne, lemon juice and zest, plus plenty of Parmesan cheese.
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces
freshly cracked black pepper to taste

steps.text: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Stir in penne and return to a boil. Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 8 minutes. Penne will still be slightly firm.

Stir asparagus into the pot with the boiling penne pasta and bring back to a boil; cook until pasta is al dente and asparagus is tender-crisp but still bright green, about 3 more minutes. Drain pasta and asparagus.
Place penne and asparagus into a large bowl; lightly stir in lemon zest, lemon juice, Parmesan cheese, olive oil, salt, and black pepper until thoroughly combined.
